players.product: merchant power supplies / power shelves (FlexPower) for AI racks

quarterly_data.signal: On September 3, 2026 Flex agreed to acquire EPC Power, a provider of power conversion solutions for data center and grid applications engineered for next-generation 800V data center power architectures, with capabilities across rectifiers, DC-DC conversion and planned development of solid-state transformers; EPC Power is expected to become part of Flex's Cloud and Power Infrastructure segment at closing, expected in the fourth quarter of calendar 2026. EPC Power has more than 15 GW deployed across 62 countries, and its annual U.S. manufacturing capacity will surpass 30 GW in 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 15 GW deployed across 62 countries; annual U.S. manufacturing capacity to surpass 30 GW in 2027
